name: Logos
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site customer logo strip (Webflow CMS collection list div-block-250, seen under the main content of the survey creator page), matched to the live ahaslides.com: a row of greyscale customer logos that loops left across the page. The logos are not typed into the markup; they come from marketing/data/logos-cms.json, the published CMS list recorded with its source URL and fetch date. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Customer logo strip from the Webflow CMS, greyscale and looping left, matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px, 991px, 767px and 390px
Logo list rendered from marketing/data/logos-cms.json (name, image URL, order), not hand-typed; the list is shown twice so the loop has no gap
Slides left over 20s, linear, repeating, as the Webflow Infinite logo interaction does; stops under reduced motion
Logos are greyscale (saturate 0); 80px wide at most, 110px at 1920px; 40px tall at 991px and below, 60px tall at 479px and below
Second copy of the list is hidden from assistive technology; the strip has no hover or click behaviour, as on live
